```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# ==============================================================================

# ==============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(gtsummary)
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# DATA PREPARATION FOR RISK-SET MATCHING (Corrected)
# ==============================================================================
target_dir <- "/n/home06/xyzhou/Frailty/2_data analysis/before and after cancer/data"
fi_trajectory <- readRDS(file.path(target_dir, "FI_longitudinal_1986_2020_IMPUTED_Cancer.rds"))
target_cycles <- c("88", "92", "96", "00", "04", "08", "12", "16", "20")

# 1. Extract Baseline Covariates (Cycle 86)
# REVERTED: Using age_enrollment to prevent drop_na() from wiping the dataset
baseline_covs <- fi_trajectory %>%
  filter(cycle == "86") %>%
  select(
    id,
    base_race    = race,
    base_marital = marital_status,
    base_living  = living_arr,
    base_pckgr   = pckgr,
    age_months   = age_enrollment 
  ) %>%
  mutate(base_age = age_months / 12) %>%
  select(-age_months) %>%
  drop_na()

cat("Diagnostic: Number of patients with full baseline data:", nrow(baseline_covs), "\n")

# 2. Create Continuous Exact Years and Identify Baseline Cancers
fi_prep <- fi_trajectory %>%
  filter(cycle %in% target_cycles) %>%
  mutate(
    Year_exact = 1900 + (worked_rtmnyr / 12),
    Year_Cancer = if_else(!is.na(cancer_dateca), 1900 + (cancer_dateca / 12), NA_real_),
    Year_death  = if_else(!is.na(dtdth), 1900 + (dtdth / 12), NA_real_)
  )

baseline_cancer_ids <- fi_trajectory %>%
  filter(cycle == "86", fi_cancer == 1) %>%
  pull(id)

# 3. Build FULL Analytic Cohort (analysis_long)
analysis_long <- fi_prep %>%
  filter(!id %in% baseline_cancer_ids) %>%
  inner_join(baseline_covs, by = "id") %>%
  mutate(
    everCancer = if_else(!is.na(Year_Cancer), 1L, 0L),
    fi_score_nocancer = if_else(n_answered_nocancer < 20, NA_real_, fi_score_nocancer),
    
    base_race    = as.factor(base_race),
    base_marital = as.factor(base_marital),
    base_living  = as.factor(base_living),
    base_pckgr   = as.factor(base_pckgr),
    
    # CORRECTED TERMINAL DECLINE logic using exact years
    # (Death Year minus Survey Year). Positive means death is in the future.
    time_to_death_exact = Year_death - Year_exact,
    terminal_decline = if_else(!is.na(time_to_death_exact) & time_to_death_exact >= 0 & time_to_death_exact <= 2, 1L, 0L)
  ) %>%
  filter(participated == 1, !is.na(fi_score_nocancer)) %>%
  group_by(id) %>% 
  filter(n() >= 2) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Year_num = Year_exact) %>% 
  arrange(id, Year_num)

cat("Diagnostic: Rows in analysis_long before matching:", nrow(analysis_long), "\n")

# 4. Create Rigorous Patient-Level Summary File for the Matcher
patient_summary <- analysis_long %>%
  arrange(id, Year_num) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    Year_base     = min(Year_num),
    Year_last_obs = max(Year_num), 
    Year_Cancer   = first(Year_Cancer), 
    everCancer    = first(everCancer),
    base_age      = first(base_age),
    base_race     = first(base_race),
    base_fi       = first(fi_score_nocancer),
    Year_death    = first(Year_death),
    .groups = "drop" # Mutes the dplyr group warning
  ) 

# Quick Sanity Check
cat("Total eligible cases:", sum(patient_summary$everCancer == 1), "\n")
cat("Total eligible controls:", sum(patient_summary$everCancer == 0), "\n")
```

## 2. Risk-Set Matching (Incidence Density Sampling)

```{r risk_set_matching}
# Create Rigorous Patient-Level Summary File for the Matcher
patient_summary <- analysis_long %>%
  arrange(id, Year_num) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    Year_base = min(Year_num),
    Year_last_obs = max(Year_num), 
    Year_Cancer = first(Year_Cancer), 
    everCancer = first(everCancer),
    base_age = first(base_age),
    base_race = first(base_race),
    base_fi = first(fi_score_nocancer),
    Year_death = first(Year_death)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

cases <- patient_summary %>% filter(everCancer == 1L)

# The Risk-Set Matching Loop
set.seed(12345) 

matched_cohort <- map_dfr(1:nrow(cases), function(i) {
  
  current_case <- cases[i, ]
  index_year <- current_case$Year_Cancer
  
  eligible_controls <- patient_summary %>%
    filter(
      id != current_case$id, 
      Year_base <= index_year, 
      (is.na(Year_death) | Year_death >= index_year),
      Year_last_obs >= index_year,
      (is.na(Year_Cancer) | Year_Cancer > index_year)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      base_race == current_case$base_race,                   
      abs(base_age - current_case$base_age) <= 2,            
      abs(base_fi - current_case$base_fi) <= 0.05            
    )
  
  if(nrow(eligible_controls) >= 2) {
    selected_controls <- eligible_controls %>% sample_n(2)
  } else if(nrow(eligible_controls) == 1) {
    selected_controls <- eligible_controls 
  } else {
    selected_controls <- NULL 
  }
  
  if(!is.null(selected_controls)) {
    bind_rows(
      current_case %>% mutate(match_id = i, role = "Case", Index_Year = index_year),
      selected_controls %>% mutate(match_id = i, role = "Control", Index_Year = index_year)
    )
  } else {
    NULL # Drop unmatched cases
  }
})

# Rebuild the Longitudinal Dataset & Set Relative Time
matched_analysis_long <- matched_cohort %>%
  select(id, match_id, role, Index_Year, base_fi) %>%

  left_join(analysis_long, by = "id", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  
  mutate(
    tRel = Year_num - Index_Year,
    is_case = if_else(role == "Case", 1L, 0L),
    
    postEvent = if_else(tRel >= 0, 1L, 0L),
    timeAfterEvent = if_else(postEvent == 1L, tRel, 0)
    # terminal_decline is already precisely carried over from analysis_long
  ) %>%
  filter(tRel >= -12 & tRel <= 12)

# Save the matched dataset to the specified directory
saveRDS(matched_analysis_long, "/n/home06/xyzhou/Frailty/2_data analysis/before and after cancer/data/matched_analysis_long.rds")
cat("Matched dataset saved successfully. Number of matched observations:", nrow(matched_analysis_long), "\n")
```

```{r table_one, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# 1. Extract the "Baseline" state for each matched patient
table1_data <- matched_analysis_long %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  # Sort so the observation closest to the Index Year (tRel = 0) is first
  arrange(abs(tRel)) %>%
  slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  # Select only the variables needed for the table
  select(
    role, 
    base_age, 
    base_race, 
    base_marital, 
    base_living, 
    base_pckgr, 
    base_fi
  )

# 2. Build a publication-ready Table 1
table1_data %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = role, # Split columns by Case vs. Control
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    missing_text = "Missing",
    label = list(
      base_age ~ "Age at Match (Years)",
      base_race ~ "Race",
      base_marital ~ "Marital Status",
      base_living ~ "Living Arrangement",
      base_pckgr ~ "Smoking History",
      base_fi ~ "Frailty Index at Match"
    )
  ) %>%
  # add_p() calculates p-values. In a perfectly matched cohort, 
  # age, race, and base_fi should have p-values close to 1.00!
  add_p() %>% 
  modify_header(label = "**Variable**") %>%
  modify_caption("**Table 1: Baseline Characteristics at Index Year**") %>%
  as_kable_extra() # Formats beautifully for HTML/PDF markdown outputs
```
```{r empirical_trajectories, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# 1. Calculate raw empirical means binned by whole years
empirical_trends <- matched_analysis_long %>%
  # Bin time to the nearest half-year or whole year to ensure enough sample size per point
  mutate(tRel_binned = round(tRel * 2) / 2) %>% 
  group_by(role, tRel_binned) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(),
    mean_FI = mean(fi_score_nocancer, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_FI = sd(fi_score_nocancer, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Only plot points that have at least 10 observations to avoid wild variance at the tails
  filter(n_obs >= 10)

# 2. Plot the empirical trends
ggplot(empirical_trends, aes(x = tRel_binned, y = mean_FI, color = role, fill = role)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", size = 1) +
  # Add confidence bands
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_FI - 1.96*se_FI, ymax = mean_FI + 1.96*se_FI), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Case" = "#D55E00", "Control" = "#0072B2")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Case" = "#D55E00", "Control" = "#0072B2")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Empirical (Unmodeled) Mean Frailty Trajectories",
    subtitle = "Points represent raw averages at 6-month intervals",
    x = "Years Relative to Index Year (Cancer Diagnosis)",
    y = "Mean Non-Cancer Frailty Index",
    color = "Cohort",
    fill = "Cohort"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
```{r mortality_attrition}
# Check the severity of death/attrition during the follow-up window
attrition_summary <- matched_analysis_long %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  arrange(tRel) %>%
  summarise(
    role = first(role),
    max_tRel = max(tRel),
    died_during_fu = any(!is.na(Year_death) & Year_death <= (first(Index_Year) + 12)),
    hit_terminal_decline = any(terminal_decline == 1)
  ) %>%
  group_by(role) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Patients = n(),
    Median_FollowUp_Years = median(max_tRel, na.rm = TRUE),
    Died_within_12_Years = sum(died_during_fu),
    Pct_Died = round((Died_within_12_Years / Total_Patients) * 100, 1),
    Patients_in_Terminal_Decline = sum(hit_terminal_decline)
  )

kable(attrition_summary, caption = "Follow-up and Mortality Attrition Analysis")
```



## 3. Matched Piecewise Mixed-Effects Model

```{r run_model}
matched_mod_fixed <- lmer(
  fi_score_nocancer ~ 
    # 1. Main Control Trajectory (A smooth, continuous aging line)
    tRel + 
    
    # 2. Pre-Event Baseline Differences for Cases
    is_case +                # Did cases start at a different frailty level?
    tRel:is_case +           # Were cases aging at a different speed BEFORE the cancer?
    
    # 3. Post-Event Discontinuities (RESTRICTED TO CASES ONLY using ':')
    postEvent:is_case +      # The acute jump in frailty caused by the cancer
    timeAfterEvent:is_case + # The change in aging speed caused by the cancer
    
    # 4. Covariates (Updated to terminal_decline)
    base_marital + base_living + base_pckgr + terminal_decline +
    
    # 5. Random Effects
    (1 + tRel | match_id/id), 
  
  data = matched_analysis_long,
  REML = TRUE,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5))
)

summary(matched_mod_fixed)
```

## 4. Visualization (Mortality-Adjusted)

```{r visualization, fig.width=11, fig.height=6}
# 1. Create Explicit Pre and Post Prediction Grids
grid_pre <- expand.grid(
  tRel = seq(-16, 0, by = 0.25),
  role = c("Case", "Control")
) %>%
  mutate(
    is_case = if_else(role == "Case", 1L, 0L),
    postEvent = 0L,
    timeAfterEvent = 0,
    
    # Hold the terminal drop variable constant at 0 (Not dying)
    terminal_decline = 0L,
    
    base_marital = levels(matched_analysis_long$base_marital)[1],
    base_living  = levels(matched_analysis_long$base_living)[1],
    base_pckgr   = levels(matched_analysis_long$base_pckgr)[1]
  )

grid_post <- expand.grid(
  tRel = seq(0, 16, by = 0.25),
  role = c("Case", "Control")
) %>%
  mutate(
    is_case = if_else(role == "Case", 1L, 0L),
    postEvent = 1L,
    timeAfterEvent = tRel,
    
    # Hold the terminal drop variable constant at 0 (Not dying)
    terminal_decline = 0L,
    
    base_marital = levels(matched_analysis_long$base_marital)[1],
    base_living  = levels(matched_analysis_long$base_living)[1],
    base_pckgr   = levels(matched_analysis_long$base_pckgr)[1]
  )

# 2. Predict Marginal Means using the mortality-adjusted model
grid_pre$pred_FI <- predict(matched_mod_fixed, newdata = grid_pre, re.form = NA)
grid_post$pred_FI <- predict(matched_mod_fixed, newdata = grid_post, re.form = NA)

# 3. Clean Split for Plotting the "Jump"
jump_points <- bind_rows(grid_pre, grid_post) %>%
  filter(tRel == 0) %>%
  select(role, postEvent, pred_FI) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = postEvent, values_from = pred_FI, names_prefix = "post_") %>%
  rename(y_pre = post_0, y_post = post_1)

# 4. Plot the Trajectories
ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = grid_pre, aes(x = tRel, y = pred_FI, color = role), linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_line(data = grid_post, aes(x = tRel, y = pred_FI, color = role), linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_segment(data = jump_points, 
               aes(x = 0, xend = 0, y = y_pre, yend = y_post, color = role), 
               linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray30") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Case" = "#D55E00", "Control" = "#0072B2")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 8)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mortality-Adjusted Frailty Trajectories",
    subtitle = "Matched controls vs. incident cancer, controlling for terminal decline",
    x = "Years relative to Index Year (0 = Diagnosis for Cases)",
    y = "Predicted non-cancer FI"
  )
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 0. RELOAD THE PRISTINE DATASET
# This wipes out any corrupted ".x" or ".y" columns from previous failed runs
# ==============================================================================
matched_analysis_long <- readRDS("/n/home06/xyzhou/Frailty/2_data analysis/before and after cancer/data/matched_analysis_long.rds")


# ==============================================================================
# 1. CALCULATE SURVIVAL & CREATE THE MATCH MAPPING
# ==============================================================================

# 1. Calculate survival and define initial Case strata
matched_analysis_long <- matched_analysis_long %>%
  mutate(
    survival_from_index = if_else(!is.na(Year_death), Year_death - Index_Year, NA_real_),
    base_stratum = case_when(
      role == "Control" ~ "Control",
      role == "Case" & survival_from_index < 5 ~ "Case: Short-Term (< 5 yrs)",
      role == "Case" & (survival_from_index >= 5 | is.na(survival_from_index)) ~ "Case: Long-Term (5+ yrs)"
    )
  )

# 2. Build map linking every match_id to its Case's stratum
case_strata_map <- matched_analysis_long %>%
  filter(role == "Case") %>%
  select(match_id, case_survivor_stratum = base_stratum) %>%
  group_by(match_id) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

# 3. Join map back to assign controls to their matched strata and build dummies
matched_analysis_long <- matched_analysis_long %>%
  left_join(case_strata_map, by = "match_id") %>%
  mutate(
    plot_stratum = case_when(
      role == "Case" ~ case_survivor_stratum,
      role == "Control" & case_survivor_stratum == "Case: Short-Term (< 5 yrs)" ~ "Control: Matched to Short-Term",
      role == "Control" & case_survivor_stratum == "Case: Long-Term (5+ yrs)" ~ "Control: Matched to Long-Term",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_ # Drop orphaned controls
    ),
    
    # Binary dummy variables for the mixed-effects model
    is_short_term_case    = if_else(plot_stratum == "Case: Short-Term (< 5 yrs)", 1L, 0L, missing = 0L),
    is_long_term_case     = if_else(plot_stratum == "Case: Long-Term (5+ yrs)", 1L, 0L, missing = 0L),
    is_short_term_control = if_else(plot_stratum == "Control: Matched to Short-Term", 1L, 0L, missing = 0L)
  )


# ==============================================================================
# 2. CALCULATE EMPIRICAL MEANS & PLOT
# ==============================================================================

# A. Prepare data for the empirical plot (Filtering out NAs/Orphans)
empirical_stratified_fixed <- matched_analysis_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(plot_stratum)) %>% 
  mutate(tRel_binned = round(tRel * 2) / 2) %>% 
  group_by(plot_stratum, tRel_binned) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(),
    mean_FI = mean(fi_score_nocancer, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_FI = sd(fi_score_nocancer, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_obs >= 10)

# B. Plot the corrected 4-line graph
ggplot(empirical_stratified_fixed, aes(x = tRel_binned, y = mean_FI, color = plot_stratum, fill = plot_stratum)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Case: Short-Term (< 5 yrs)" = "#D55E00", 
    "Control: Matched to Short-Term" = "#E69F00", 
    "Case: Long-Term (5+ yrs)" = "#0072B2", 
    "Control: Matched to Long-Term" = "#56B4E9"  
  )) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Pair-Matched Survival-Stratified Frailty Trajectories",
    subtitle = "Controls are now correctly stratified by their matched case's survival outcome",
    x = "Years Relative to Index Year (Cancer Diagnosis)",
    y = "Mean Non-Cancer Frailty Index",
    color = "Cohort Strategy"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "vertical")
```



```{r}
matched_mod_4strata <- lmer(
  fi_score_nocancer ~ 
    # 1. Reference Line: Controls Matched to Long-Term Cases
    tRel + 
    
    # 2. Baseline & Pre-Event Slope Differences
    is_short_term_control + tRel:is_short_term_control + 
    is_short_term_case + tRel:is_short_term_case +       
    is_long_term_case + tRel:is_long_term_case +         
    
    # 3. Post-Event Discontinuities (Acute Jump at Diagnosis - Cases ONLY)
    postEvent:is_short_term_case + 
    postEvent:is_long_term_case + 
    
    # 4. Post-Event Slope Changes (Long-term Trajectory - Cases ONLY)
    timeAfterEvent:is_short_term_case + 
    timeAfterEvent:is_long_term_case +
    
    # 5. Covariates
    base_marital + base_living + base_pckgr + terminal_decline +
    
    # 6. Random Effects
    (1 + tRel | match_id/id), 
  
  data = matched_analysis_long,
  REML = TRUE,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5))
)

summary(matched_mod_4strata)

```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# PART 5: VISUALIZE MODELED PREDICTIONS
# ==============================================================================
cat("\nGenerating Modeled Prediction Trajectories...\n")

# 1. Create prediction grid explicitly split at 0
time_seq <- c(seq(-12, -0.01, by = 0.1), seq(0, 12, by = 0.1))

grid_lt_control <- data.frame(tRel = time_seq, plot_stratum = "Control: Matched to Long-Term", 
                              is_short_term_control = 0, is_short_term_case = 0, is_long_term_case = 0)

grid_st_control <- data.frame(tRel = time_seq, plot_stratum = "Control: Matched to Short-Term", 
                              is_short_term_control = 1, is_short_term_case = 0, is_long_term_case = 0)

grid_st_case <- data.frame(tRel = time_seq, plot_stratum = "Case: Short-Term (< 5 yrs)", 
                           is_short_term_control = 0, is_short_term_case = 1, is_long_term_case = 0)

grid_lt_case <- data.frame(tRel = time_seq, plot_stratum = "Case: Long-Term (5+ yrs)", 
                           is_short_term_control = 0, is_short_term_case = 0, is_long_term_case = 1)

pred_grid <- bind_rows(grid_lt_control, grid_st_control, grid_st_case, grid_lt_case) %>%
  mutate(
    postEvent = if_else(tRel >= 0, 1L, 0L),
    timeAfterEvent = if_else(postEvent == 1L, tRel, 0),
    base_marital = levels(matched_analysis_long$base_marital)[1],
    base_living  = levels(matched_analysis_long$base_living)[1],
    base_pckgr   = levels(matched_analysis_long$base_pckgr)[1],
    terminal_decline = 0L # Holding terminal decline at 0 to isolate cancer trajectory
  )

# Predict values
pred_grid$pred_FI <- predict(matched_mod_4strata, newdata = pred_grid, re.form = NA)

# 2. Plot the 4 lines
ggplot(pred_grid, aes(x = tRel, y = pred_FI, color = plot_stratum)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Case: Short-Term (< 5 yrs)" = "#D55E00", 
    "Control: Matched to Short-Term" = "#E69F00", 
    "Case: Long-Term (5+ yrs)" = "#0072B2", 
    "Control: Matched to Long-Term" = "#56B4E9"  
  )) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Modeled Frailty Trajectories by Survival Stratum",
    subtitle = "Marginal predictions from 4-strata piecewise mixed-effects model",
    x = "Years Relative to Index Year (Cancer Diagnosis)",
    y = "Predicted Non-Cancer Frailty Index",
    color = "Cohort Strategy"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom", 
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-16, 16, by = 4))
```

```{r}

# Predict values
pred_grid$pred_FI <- predict(matched_mod_4strata_2, newdata = pred_grid, re.form = NA)

# 2. Plot the 4 lines
ggplot(pred_grid, aes(x = tRel, y = pred_FI, color = plot_stratum)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Case: Short-Term (< 5 yrs)" = "#D55E00", 
    "Control: Matched to Short-Term" = "#E69F00", 
    "Case: Long-Term (5+ yrs)" = "#0072B2", 
    "Control: Matched to Long-Term" = "#56B4E9"  
  )) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Modeled Frailty Trajectories by Survival Stratum",
    subtitle = "Marginal predictions from 4-strata piecewise mixed-effects model",
    x = "Years Relative to Index Year (Cancer Diagnosis)",
    y = "Predicted Non-Cancer Frailty Index",
    color = "Cohort Strategy"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom", 
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-16, 16, by = 4))
```
